title: DynamicsKit.jl: Bifurcation analysis of dynamical systems in Julia
description: A Julia library for bifurcation analysis of dynamical systems — discrete maps and continuous-time ODEs analysed through Poincaré sections and return maps. Direct exploration provides threaded parameter sweeps: 1-D diagrams, basins of attraction, and uniform or adaptive 2-D operating maps with period, status, and Lyapunov diagnostics. Continuation wraps BifurcationKit.jl pseudo-arclength with shooting and collocation, and extends it with codim-2 curve tracking and normal-form classification, connecting-orbit continuation from homoclinic to cycle-to-cycle connections, border-collision classification with scenario prediction, and grazing/sliding diagnostics for piecewise-smooth flows; an atlas maps periodic branches and windows automatically. An engineering layer generates switching maps directly from circuit descriptions, assigns branch reachability, computes tolerance and regime-boundary fields, certifies robust chaos over parameter bands and two-parameter regions, tests measured hardware routes against those certificates, and searches for operating points from signal specifications. Eligible discrete sweeps, independent-trajectory ODE maps and basins, and the variational continuous-flow Lyapunov field accelerate on CUDA or AMDGPU devices. Results serialise as versioned plain data with explicit refusal semantics.
